Photo 1: Front screen of the phone showing a working display with app icons (Samsung, Google, OneDrive, Play Store, etc.) and status bar. Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI ABBA GSM'.
Photo 2: Phone partially folded, showing left half of inner screen lit with solid green, right half black and reflective. Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI ABBA GSM'.

read_from: photo 0: camera module design and back panel layout typical of Samsung Galaxy Z Fold series
photo 1: UI with Samsung-specific icons and layout

claims.claim: One screen is working perfect but inner screen blank
claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows the front screen working with apps and status bar. Photo 2 shows the inner screen partially lit (left half green) and right half blank, consistent with a partial failure.

risks.risk: Inner screen has partial or complete failure (right half blank in photo 2)
risks.proof: Video or photo showing the inner screen fully powered on and displaying content, or a diagnostic test screen.

risks.risk: Hinge or folding mechanism damage or wear
risks.proof: Close-up video or photo of the hinge area while folding/unfolding, showing any gaps, misalignment, or creasing.

risks.risk: Front screen has dead pixels, burn-in, or touch issues not visible in photo 1
risks.proof: Photo or video of the front screen displaying full white, full black, and color gradients, and a touch test.
risks.if_unproven: priced as front screen possibly defective

proof_requests: Video of the inner screen fully powered on and displaying content (e.g., home screen or video playback).
Close-up video of the hinge while folding and unfolding.
Photo or video of the front screen displaying full white, full black, and color gradients.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a Samsung Galaxy Z Fold with a working front screen and a partially non-functional inner screen. The seller's claim is supported by the photos. Hidden risks include inner screen failure, hinge issues, and front screen defects, which are priced at their worst case until proven otherwise.
